name: human-operation-simulator
description: A deterministic Windows desktop automation simulator.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hos/contracts && npm run build --workspace @hos/control-server && npm run build --workspace @hos/operator-web
scripts.check: npm run check:node && npm run check:dotnet && npm run test:integration:m1
scripts.check:dotnet: dotnet restore HumanOperationSimulator.slnx && dotnet format HumanOperationSimulator.slnx --verify-no-changes --no-restore && dotnet build HumanOperationSimulator.slnx --no-restore && dotnet test HumanOperationSimulator.slnx --no-build
scripts.check:node: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: npm run format:node && dotnet format HumanOperationSimulator.slnx
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @hos/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @hos/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
